title: Chapter 129
text:
On the four continents of the Blue Star, there were many new arrival points. The number of open beta players kept increasing, but compared to the population of the entire planet, it was still very small. Players were doing beginner missions and growing slowly. Most of them stayed near the beginner village. Players in Big Horn Village became the object of envy. They could meet a high-level figure (Han Xiao) who taught them basic knowledge. Players in other beginner villages could only work hard to level up their secondary professions.

Players could be divided into three types: casual players, studio players, and professional esports players.

At this time, there was a live broadcast of a press conference on the forum. It was about the pillar of China's esports powerhouse, Temple of God, the second best esports player in China and the 21st best esports player in the world, Li Ge, officially announced that he would be joining Galaxy!

The number of viewers had reached millions! And it was still rising!

"Master Li Ge, may I ask if your focus will be shifted to Galaxy from now on?"

"Why did you choose to join the open beta?"

"Excuse me …"

Facing the questions of the reporters, Li Ge spoke frankly. He was a very handsome young man. He always had a gentle smile on his face, which was very infectious. With strong skills and good looks, Li Ge had a very large fan base.

"'Galaxy' is a game that transcends its time, and it has a lot of potential. It has countless possibilities, an extremely vast map, and an incredible degree of freedom, outlining an incomparably fascinating world. From my personal point of view, I believe that 'Galaxy' will become a phenomenal game. The World E-Sports Association has already started preparing for the first Professional League for 'Galaxy'. This will be a large-scale global competition. Not only me, but all the Chinese e-sports players will participate in this grand event, competing with the United States, France, Korea, and other e-sports powers to win glory for our country."

"Just yesterday, the major clubs in the United States, Key, Devil, and Thunder Snake also announced that they would enter the galaxy. They chose Planet Winterfrost, which has the most potential, as their base camp. They will be very formidable opponents. Temple of God has also contacted large esports clubs such as Long Sky and Thunder Storm. We will not fall behind! "

"Master Li Ge, your old rival, the French player 'Lost Angel', has said that he will defeat you in Galaxy. What do you think about this?" the reporter asked.

Li Ge smiled, and his tone was filled with confidence. "I am not afraid of any enemy. I will reach the top in Galaxy and lead the Chinese players to defeat all the foreign enemies!"

This press conference seemed to be a signal. The influence of Galaxy soared exponentially, and the entire esports circle began to surge. Countless esports players announced that they would fight in Galaxy.

Sleepy Winter, Twinkle Fried Rice, and Rainy Kim, who had started playing the game during the closed beta, also held a press conference under the arrangement of the club. The liveliness of the eSports scene had also increased the enthusiasm of the ordinary players. The topic was constantly hyped up, and the activity level had reached a phenomenal level! Countless players were looking forward to the pre-sale of the second batch of game cabins.

Just as the popularity of the show was increasing, the official website of Galaxy finally released the first promotional video. The scenes showed the scenery of various novice planets, which was equivalent to a quick sightseeing film. Civilizations of different styles immediately attracted enough eyeballs. Magic, technology, the future, ancient, and so on. This promotional video was recorded by players during the closed beta and was edited into a promotional CG. The video was from the perspective of the players.

This promotional video introduced the background and environment of the world through the video. The official website of Galaxy announced that they would soon release other types of promotional videos to gradually introduce the other aspects of Galaxy. They also released news that the next promotional video would focus on the battle scenes of various professions. This would allow players to better understand the battle styles of different main professions, which was highly anticipated.

The activity level of the forum was extremely high, and Han Xiao was also constantly paying attention to these developments. Each and every one of the professions that he had fought and bragged in the group made him feel a little complicated. He still remembered that at this time in his previous life, he was also a passionate novice player. Many years had passed, and not only did he become a hardcore leveler, but he had also transmigrated. Life was indeed unpredictable, and reality was much more interesting than novels.

Back then, he was one of the players who bought the second batch of game cabins. Han Xiao was very curious if there would be another him, so he had been paying attention to the forum.

For the past few days, Han Xiao had been staying in Big Horn Village. During this period, players had been attracted to him, and new players were constantly arriving.

A group of new players who had just arrived arrived at Big Horn Village and asked curiously, "This is the Novice Village, right?"

A player with a pistol on his waist walked past them and immediately attracted the attention of the new players.

"Big brother, where are you going to buy this pistol?"

"Oh, you guys are new players, right? You asked the right person. Let me tell you, don't go to Big Horn Village to buy a gun. Go straight to the west. There's a high-ranking person called Black Phantom there. He sells good and cheap guns, and you can change your profession," the player with the gun said.

"Really? Let's go take a look now! "The new players' eyes lit up.

"Go, don't forget to thank me." The player with the gun had a proud look on his face.

More new players were recommended. As soon as they entered the game, they eagerly looked for Han Xiao and then went to Big Horn Village to accept missions. They used all the money they earned to buy things to increase Han Xiao's favorability. They were like diligent bees, constantly transporting wealth to Han Xiao.

In just a few days, Han Xiao had earned a lot of money. He had earned more than 500,000 Aquamarine Dollars and almost 1,000,000 EXP. The efficiency was amazing, and it was very safe. It was much safer than him working tirelessly to complete missions. This had provided him with a huge potential to gain EXP.

The players now are all new players. When they grow up, I'll be able to earn more profit.

The function of an NPC could give him a huge advantage when facing players, but Han Xiao was very clear that there was a prerequisite. He had to always be in the lead in all aspects. Only then would he be able to squeeze benefits out of the players.

Although the situation is good now, I can't relax. Han Xiao thought to himself as he blew out a puff of smoke.

Among the players in Big Horn Village, about 20% had chosen to become a Mechanic. The rest of the players were observing. Only when he showed them the strength of a Mechanic would they be swayed.

Han Xiao looked at the computer. The Dark Net had sent a message saying that the Germinal Organization's retreating army would pass by Big Horn Village this afternoon.

As he was thinking, he suddenly heard a cute female voice.

"Black Phantom, why are you making an enemy out of the Germinal Organization?"

In front of him was a petite female player who only reached his chin. She had short hair, and her big, watery eyes were filled with curiosity. Her face was as cute as an apple, and he could not help but want to poke her cheeks with his finger. The ID above her head was' Maple Moon '. She was the first female player to learn skills from him.

"Oh, this is an acquaintance." Han Xiao raised his eyebrows as he recalled.

"Maple Moon, one of the representatives of the Mechanic's Rise in the third season. She was originally a casual player, but she made a name for herself in the third season. She was signed by a club. It was revealed on the forums that Maple Moon liked to uncover hidden stories. She kept accumulating until the third season, when the version was in favor of Mechanics.

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled as a new idea came to him.
